pages.instruction: Decida e explique com suas palavras.

pages.title: The empty closet · 1/3
paragraphs: It is nine o’clock in a small office in Portland. Tom has a lot of work today. He needs pens, paper and a working printer. He looks in the supply closet but it is almost empty. Dee, the office manager, walks by with a folder. Tom asks her for help.
“Good morning, Tom! Can I help you?” says Dee. “Yes. I need some pens and paper.” says Tom. “The pens are in the first drawer.” says Dee.

pages.title: The empty closet · 3/3
paragraphs: “Yes, but it makes a loud noise.” says Tom. “I will call the repair service.” says Dee. Dee opens the first drawer and gives Tom five pens. She writes “tape” on a small list.
